messages.details: Root cause was a faulty load balancer. Sessions have been stable for over an hour.

incidents.name: Routine Maintenance Window for Asio APAC

messages.details: Scheduled maintenance in progress. Brief login delays may occur.
The backend performance issue has been fully resolved. All services are operating as expected.
We will be performing scheduled maintenance on Friday, February 20th, 2026, from 2:00 AM to 4:00 AM EST. During this period, On-Premise purchase and renewal pages may be temporarily unavailable

upcoming.name: Planned Maintenance: ConnectWise Asio Platform, ConnectWise NOC Services and End-User Portal, February 20

messages.details:
A maintenance period is scheduled for February 20, 2026, from 8:00am to 11:00am ET (1:00pm to 4:00pm UTC). During the three-hour maintenance window, you may experience intermittent issues with the ConnectWise Asio platform, ConnectWise NOC Services, as well as the end-user (customer) portal. All functionalities will return after the maintenance period is complete, and queued tickets and alerts will be processed.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as our team works to improve our service to you. If you have any questions or concerns about this planned maintenance, please contact us at help@connectwise.com.

upcoming.name: Planned Maintenance: x360Recover Virtual Office, Mar 4

messages.details:
Notice to Partners: ConnectWise will be deploying an update to x360Recover Virtual Office early Wednesday morning, Mar 4, 2026. Deployment will occur between 4AM and 8AM EST.
Virtual Office instances and Virtual Machines that are running will not be impacted, but x360Recover Partners (Replibit, BRC) may not be able to start a new Virtual Office while deployment is taking place.
